name: Bazzalan
summary: Bazzalan commands the Searing Blade cult from the lava caverns beneath Orgrimmar. Alongside Jergosh the Invoker, he directs its work in Ragefire Chasm.

sections.title: A Serpent Beneath the City
sections.body: Beneath Orgrimmar, Bazzalan has joined the Searing Blade cult in Ragefire Chasm. While Thrall works to establish the Orcs' new home across Durotar, the satyr rogue commands the cult's field forces from winding lava caverns. He is swift and lethal with twin blades.

sections.title: Cult Leadership and Deceit
sections.body: From a volcanic ledge above the central chamber, Bazzalan oversees the cultist guards. Jergosh the Invoker conducts demonic rituals below. Like all satyrs, Bazzalan's ultimate loyalty belongs to demonic masters. He uses poison, quick strikes, and stealth against Horde scouts who venture near the cult's staging ground.

faq.answer: Bazzalan is a satyr rogue who shares leadership of the Searing Blade cult inside Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Where can Bazzalan be found in Ragefire Chasm?
faq.answer: Bazzalan lurks on the upper ledges of Ragefire Chasm, above Jergosh the Invoker. Dark ramps cut into the cavern walls lead up to him.

faq.q: What is a satyr doing beneath Orgrimmar?
aliases: why is there a satyr in orgrimmar
faq.answer: Bazzalan works with the Searing Blade, a demonic cult seeking to undermine the Horde from within. Satyrs are bound to demonic powers and often serve as instigators and assassins for shadow councils.

faq.q: What abilities does Bazzalan use in combat?
faq.answer: Bazzalan attacks swiftly with melee weapons and uses Sinister Strike. He sometimes afflicts opponents with a mild debilitating poison.

faq.q: What is his relationship to Jergosh the Invoker?
faq.answer: Bazzalan and Jergosh share leadership of the Searing Blade inside Ragefire Chasm. Jergosh handles invocations and summoning dark forces, while Bazzalan commands the cult's martial and stealth work.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want Bazzalan dead?
faq.answer: Bazzalan's presence deep beneath the capital is a direct demonic threat. Horde leaders send adventurers into Ragefire Chasm to eliminate him before the Searing Blade's plot endangers the city.

angles.text: Bazzalan and his cult pose a hazard beneath Thrall's stronghold, and the Horde wants them eliminated.
Bazzalan uses stealth, vicious strikes, and venom-coated blades, making him an opponent of particular interest to Rogues.
Orcs fought hard to escape demonic manipulation. A satyr directing cultists in their own foundations is an outrage to them.
